name: Hiddai
title: One of David's thirty mighty men
summary: Hiddai from the brooks of Gaash was one of King David's thirty mighty warriors. He is mentioned in the list of David's heroes in 2 Samuel 23. In the parallel list in 1 Chronicles 11, he is called Hurai.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned among David's thirty mighty men
keyEvents.description: Hiddai from the brooks of Gaash is listed among David's thirty mighty warriors, an elite group of soldiers who served King David with great bravery.

keyEvents.title: Parallel list in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: In the parallel list of David's heroes in 1 Chronicles, he is called Hurai from the brooks of Gaash, showing that the name has an alternative form.

keyEvents.title: David's mighty men as a group
keyEvents.description: Hiddai was part of the chosen group of thirty heroes who distinguished themselves in battle and remained loyal to David throughout his reign.

keyEvents.title: Connection to the Gaas Streams
keyEvents.description: Hiddai came from the area near the Gaas Streams, which was located close to Timnath-Serah in the hill country of Ephraim, a region known since the time of Joshua.
